title: Dedicated Autoscaling w/ Customer Bounds — Implementation Plan (Infra + Control Plane + Observability + Console)
body:
Last updated: 2026-02-12
Owner: Vanessa (Fleet) • PM: Lauren • Program: Talia

Purpose
Ship Dedicated autoscaling with customer-configured min/max bounds (hard max; min semantics per ADR-0142), plus the first iteration of predictive signals blended with reactive autoscaling (ADR-0143). Deliver strict spend guardrails + predictable performance floors, with customer-visible auditability of scaling decisions.

Non-goals (this plan)
- Automatic cross-customer cost optimization beyond honoring max
- Multi-cloud arbitrage
- Dynamic pricing tied to scaling

Success criteria (engineering)
- 0 bound violations (hard max must never be exceeded; min behavior matches ADR semantics)
- No scale-decision regressions vs existing autoscaling when bounds are unset/defaulted
- Scaling event audit trail available internally + in Console for allowlisted customers
- SLO panels + paging for bound violations, scaling lag, and oscillation are live before design partner enablement

Key design choices (summary)
- Bounds are enforced in three layers:
  1) Control plane validation (reject invalid config; enforce region/hardware constraints)
  2) Policy engine evaluation (resolve defaults deterministically; emit evaluated config)
  3) Fleet autoscaler clamp (final hard clamp; emits clamp_reason)
- Predictive scaling is gated by confidence; when confidence low/unknown -> revert to reactive-only behavior.
- Actuation respects scale-rate limits + cooldowns; must not get “stuck” due to clamp/cooldown interaction (see hotfix PR-22057).

Scope breakdown / systems to touch
A) Control plane (DedicatedPool config + persistence)
- API schema: add min_replicas/min_gpus, max_replicas/max_gpus (final naming per schema review)
- Validation:
  - min <= max
  - max within allowed quota/contractual limits (if applicable)
  - region/hardware class constraints for pool
  - multi-region pools: explicit behavior (either reject or define per-region bounds; do not allow ambiguous semantics)
- Persistence/migration: add nullable fields + backfill defaults for existing pools
Owner: Ethan (lead), Michael (migrations)

B) Policy engine (evaluate autoscaling config)
- Deterministic evaluation output:
  - resolved bounds (including defaults)
  - resolved cooldowns / scale-rate limits
  - computed derived constraints (e.g., max_step, scale_down_floor during drains)
- Backward compatibility:
  - If bounds unset, preserve existing behavior
  - If bounds set, clamp at policy + autoscaler
Owner: Jordan

C) Fleet autoscaler controller (core behavior)
- Enforce hard bounds at decision time:
  - clamp desired replicas within [min,max]
  - record clamp_reason(s) (e.g., CLAMP_MAX, CLAMP_MIN, MAINTENANCE_OVERRIDE, REGION_CAP)
- Blend reactive + predictive desired replicas:
  - compute reactive desired
  - compute forecast desired
  - choose blended desired per ADR-0143 (weighted max / safety margin + confidence gating)
- Cooldowns and scale-rate limits:
  - avoid oscillation (cooldown defaults informed by oscillation analysis)
  - ensure clamp+cooldown cannot deadlock scale-down
- Safety:
  - capacity shortage behavior (cannot satisfy min): surface as explicit status + events; do not silently violate min semantics
Owner: Keiko (lead), Jamal (capacity planning inputs)

D) Predictive signal service (MVP)
- Forecast short-horizon demand per pool:
  - Inputs: recent QPS/token rate, queue depth trends, known schedules (if provided), regional lead-time hints
  - Output: desired replicas estimate + confidence score + feature flags indicating which signals used
- Data quality checks: missing telemetry, delayed metrics, outliers
- Failure mode: if pipeline down/low confidence -> autoscaler ignores forecast
Owner: Yara (implementation), Karthik (approach), Sana (validation)

E) Telemetry + Observability (metrics, dashboards, alerts)
- Metrics/events emitted by autoscaler:
  - desired_replicas_reactive, desired_replicas_forecast, desired_replicas_blended
  - applied_replicas, clamp_reason, confidence, cooldown_active, rate_limit_applied
  - scale_latency_seconds (decision -> applied)
  - oscillation counter (scale up/down within window)
- Cardinality controls:
  - pool_id may be high-card; follow guidance: emit per-pool events to log pipeline + aggregate metrics by tier/region/hardware class
- Dashboards:
  - correctness: bound violations (should be 0), clamp counts, min-not-met due to capacity
  - performance: p95/p99 latency correlation to scaling activity
  - health: forecast pipeline status and confidence distribution
- Alerts/pages:
  - bound violation (page immediately; SEV2 default)
  - scale lag > threshold for N minutes (page on-call per runbook)
  - oscillation above threshold (ticket + optional page depending on customer impact)
Owner: Allison (lead), Aisha (alerts), Thomas (aggregation/cardinality)

F) Console (customer-facing visibility)
- Scaling History panel:
  - show events: scaled up/down, clamped, reason, evaluated bounds, timestamp, actor (system)
  - filters (time range, reason)
  - “Why did we scale?” explanation fields (inputs summary; do not expose sensitive internals)
- RBAC:
  - Enterprise admin only by default
  - retention policy (initially 14–30 days configurable; match observability constraints)
- Customer messaging:
  - warning when max too low (likely throttling) and when min too high (cost)
Owner: Chloe (backend), Felix/Nora (UI), Alicia (UX copy)

G) Rollout tooling (flags, allowlists, staged rollouts)
- Feature flags:
  - enable_bounds_enforcement (control plane + autoscaler)
  - enable_scaling_audit_trail (console)
  - enable_predictive_blending (autoscaler)
  - enable_forecast_ingestion (service)
- Allowlisting by customer + region + hardware class
- Rollback:
  - ability to freeze autoscaling per pool
  - revert to reactive-only quickly
Owner: Connor (release), Benji (flags/platform primitives)

Milestones + dates (target)
Note: dates are “week of”. Adjust based on code review bandwidth + design partner schedules.

Phase 0 — Requirements / design sign-off (DONE)
- [x] ADR-0142 bounds semantics
- [x] ADR-0143 blending approach
- [x] SLOs/alerts plan initial draft
Owners: Lauren/Talia + Jordan/Keiko/Allison

Phase 1 — Bounds config + enforcement (GA foundation)
Target: 2026-01-10 → 2026-01-31
- [x] Control plane schema + validation (ENG-2841, PR-21873)
- [x] Policy evaluation output includes resolved bounds + defaults (ENG-2842, PR-21891)
- [x] Autoscaler clamp within bounds + structured logs (ENG-2843, PR-21905)
- [x] Feature flag + allowlist scaffolding (ENG-2848, PR-21927)
Exit criteria:
- Integration tests demonstrate no applied replicas outside bounds
- Clamp_reason emitted and visible in internal logs
- Backward compatibility test suite passing

Phase 2 — Observability + audit trail (pre-design partner)
Target: 2026-01-24 → 2026-02-14
- [x] Decision metrics w/ cardinality guardrails (ENG-2846, PR-21912)
- [x] Dashboards + alerts merged (observability-pack PR-842)
- [x] Console API endpoints for scaling audit events (ENG-2847, PR-22003)
- [x] Console UI Scaling History panel (ENG-2847, PR-22011)
Exit criteria:
- On-call can answer: “Did we clamp? Why? For how long? What was desired vs applied?”
- Bound violation alert wired to paging and runbook references
- Console shows events correctly for internal dogfood pools

Phase 3 — Predictive signals MVP + blending (gated)
Target: 2026-02-03 → 2026-03-01
- [x] Forecast ingestion interface stubbed + confidence gating scaffolding (ENG-2844, PR-21941)
- [x] Blending algorithm implementation (ENG-2845, PR-21966)
- [ ] Predictive signal service MVP producing forecast+confidence (ENG-2844)
- [ ] Autoscaler consumes real forecast from service in staging + dogfood
- [ ] Data quality checks + “forecast disabled” circuit breaker
Exit criteria:
- When confidence low or pipeline unhealthy, behavior == reactive-only (verified via canary)
- Forecast-enabled pools reduce scaling lag during ramps without increasing oscillation

Phase 4 — Migration/backfill + defaults for existing pools
Target: 2026-02-10 → 2026-03-10
- [x] Backfill job tooling + dry-run mode (ENG-2850, PR-22042)
- [ ] Decide defaults by tier/region/hardware (input from oscillation analysis + fleet constraints)
- [ ] Execute dry-run; review diffs w/ Support + CS; then staged backfill
Exit criteria:
- No surprise spend increases: defaults must be conservative
- Customer comms and support macros ready

Phase 5 — Design partner rollout
Target: 2026-03-01 → 2026-03-31
Design partners (tentative): NorthPeak (hard max focus), HelioSearch (forecast/ramp focus)
- Enable flags by region/hardware class; daily checks during week 1
- Weekly retro with design partners; feed findings into defaults + UI warnings
Exit criteria:
- No bound violations
- At least one partner validates max spend protection + audit logs meet expectations
- Predictive signal reduces ramp latency spikes in at least one workload (measured)

Implementation checklist (by subsystem)
Control plane
- [ ] Field naming finalized (min_gpus vs min_replicas) across API + persistence + docs
- [ ] Validation errors are actionable (SUP-4922: clearer messages for multi-region)
- [ ] Migration: add columns/fields + backfill script + rollback plan
- [ ] Audit config changes (who changed min/max, when) — if not in v1, document limitation and planned follow-up

Policy engine
- [ ] Golden tests for determinism (same input -> same evaluated config)
- [ ] Defaulting rules documented (esp. when only min or only max is set)
- [ ] Explicit output fields for autoscaler (avoid re-deriving semantics in autoscaler)

Autoscaler
- [ ] Clamp logic and clamp_reason codes stable (doc string + runbook)
- [ ] Scale-rate limits + cooldown interactions tested under clamp
- [ ] Maintenance/drain semantics match ADR (min may be best-effort during drains; max always hard)
- [ ] Emergency override: freeze scaling / pin replicas

Predictive service
- [ ] Feature set defined (v0) + aggregation windows
- [ ] Confidence definition documented (what is “good enough”)
- [ ] Backfill/bootstrapping when new pool has no history
- [ ] Failure modes tested: delayed telemetry, missing metrics, outlier spikes

Telemetry/Observability
- [ ] Metrics have bounded label sets; pool_id only in event logs, not primary time-series
- [ ] SLO panels merged and linked from runbook
- [ ] Paging thresholds approved by SRE leadership (see Sean thread)

Console
- [ ] Pagination + retention policy validated (avoid expensive queries)
- [ ] RBAC checks; audit panel behind allowlist initially
- [ ] Customer warning copy for “max too low” and “min too high” scenarios

Rollout
- [ ] Allowlist mechanism tested end-to-end
- [ ] Rollback tested (disable forecast; disable bounds; freeze scaling)
- [ ] Load test scenario created for bounded scaling ramps (perf-canary)

Risk register
1) Clamp + cooldown deadlock / stuck at min
- Likelihood: Medium • Impact: High
- Mitigation: targeted integration tests; monitor “cooldown_active + clamp_min for >X min”; hotfix path (PR-22057 precedent)
- Owner: Keiko

2) Max too low leads to throttling and customer-perceived regression
- Likelihood: High (customers will set conservative max) • Impact: Medium/High
- Mitigation: Console warnings + docs; recommend “burst to max” with cooldown; provide sizing guidance; Support macros
- Owner: Lauren + Chloe + Dev Patel

3) Forecast overprovisions overnight (SUP-4910 pattern)
- Likelihood: Medium • Impact: High (cost trust)
- Mitigation: confidence gating; cap forecast contribution; require persistent signal; audit forecast inputs; rapid disable flag
- Owner: Yara + Sana + Keiko

4) Fleet capacity shortages prevent meeting min
- Likelihood: Medium (regional GPU constraints) • Impact: High (SLO hits + contract risk)
- Mitigation: explicit status surfaced; capacity planning alerts; pre-warm reservations for enterprise tiers; communicate best-effort min semantics where applicable
- Owner: Jamal + Vanessa

5) Observability cost/cardinality blow-up
- Likelihood: Medium • Impact: Medium
- Mitigation: aggregate metrics by region/hw/tier; per-pool details in logs only; sampling if needed
- Owner: Thomas + Allison

6) Multi-region semantics confusion
- Likelihood: Medium • Impact: Medium
- Mitigation: either disallow in v1 or require per-region bounds; improve validation errors (SUP-4922)
- Owner: Ethan + Jordan

Open questions / decisions needed
- Defaults for existing pools (min/max):
  - Per GPU type + region? Based on historical peak? Contracted baseline? Need FP&A input for spend predictability.
  - Owner: Vanessa + Nadia + Jamal
- “Hard min” semantics during maintenance/drains:
  - ADR-0142 indicates best-effort min in certain maintenance states; ensure customer-facing docs match.
  - Owner: Jordan + Sean
- Audit trail for config changes (not just scaling decisions):
  - Customers (OmniComply) asked for who-changed-min/max. Is that v1 or v1.5?
  - Owner: Chloe + Marcus
- Scheduled traffic patterns input:
  - Do we accept customer-provided schedules in v1 (UI/API)? If not, document workaround.
  - Owner: Lauren + Yara

Testing plan (minimum)
- Unit tests:
  - schema validation (min<=max, invalid combos)
  - policy evaluation defaulting
  - clamp behavior
- Integration tests:
  - apply evaluated config -> autoscaler decision -> actuation within bounds
  - cooldown/clamp interactions
- Load/perf tests:
  - ramp: sudden 10x QPS increase; measure scale lag + latency
  - burst: short spike; verify does not exceed max; verify cooldown prevents thrash
  - forecast failure: turn off forecast mid-ramp; verify reverts to reactive-only
- Gameday:
  - prediction pipeline down
  - max clamp leads to throttling; ensure operators follow runbook + customer messaging
Owner: Leila (QA), Aisha (gameday), Keiko (scenarios)

Ops notes / runbook hooks
- Runbook must include:
  - interpreting clamp_reason
  - freezing autoscaling and pinning replicas
  - debugging forecast confidence drops
  - diagnosing capacity shortage vs autoscaler bug
- Paging ownership:
  - bound violation -> Fleet autoscaler on-call (Keiko primary) + SRE secondary
  - forecast pipeline unhealthy -> Applied ML on-call (Yara) + SRE

Comms dependencies
- Support macros and escalation checklist (INT-1338)
- Customer-facing docs: “How to set min/max without throttling” + “What does clamp mean?”
- Design partner enablement email + rollback commitments (Vanessa thread 2026-01-22)

Notes to self (Vanessa)
- Re-check regional supply constraints before enabling min>0 for new regions; don’t create implicit guarantees we can’t meet.
- Push for explicit surfaced state “MIN_UNSATISFIED_DUE_TO_CAPACITY” so we don’t silently mask fleet shortages.
